name: Sigilmassasaurus
isnote: Wikipedia calls it a controversial genus; some analyses treat its material as Spinosaurus (see Evers et al. 2015 cited there), others keep it separate.
sum: Controversial spinosaurid from the Cenomanian of northern Africa, known mainly from neck vertebrae.
holotype: Not given in the sources used.
material: Not given in the sources used.
